faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Insights into my working style and technical philosophy.

items.question: Are you open to relocation, and do you need visa sponsorship?
items.answer: Yes to both. I am based in Isfahan, Iran and I am targeting the Netherlands, Germany and Austria, where I would need full visa sponsorship. I say this upfront because it is easier to check early than to discover it late in a process.

items.question: What kind of role are you looking for?
items.answer: A hands-on senior individual-contributor role — frontend architecture, performance and testing. I currently lead a squad and a frontend chapter, and that experience shapes the technical decisions I make, but I want to keep building rather than move into management.

items.question: How quickly could you start?
items.answer: My notice period is 2 to 4 weeks, which is short for a senior role. The realistic constraint on a start date is the work-permit timeline rather than my availability.

items.question: How do you handle performance optimization?
items.answer: I take a data-driven approach: using Lighthouse and performance profilers to identify bottlenecks, then applying techniques like code-splitting, memoization, and server-side rendering to improve metrics. At Kasra this produced a 25% faster initial load and Core Web Vitals 'Green'.

items.question: What is your approach to mentorship?
items.answer: I believe in 'leading by doing'. I support developers through pair programming, constructive code reviews, and weekly knowledge-sharing sessions on advanced React patterns and AI tooling.
